items.period: Shang-style oracle script (modern redraw of an ancient form; exact exemplar identified on Commons as Xiaoxuetang image 41.E045)
items.caption: A modern vector redraw of a Shang-style oracle-bone form of 天, showing the early graph discussed as a person with an emphasized head.
items.alt: Black oracle-script glyph for 天, redrawn as a vector.
items.selection_reason: The exact Commons description identifies the character, its script style, specific Xiaoxuetang source image, and reuse rights. It illustrates the head-mark interpretation while remaining clearly identified as a modern redraw.
items.rights: CC0 1.0 as stated on the Commons description page; the page also attributes the source glyph image to Xiaoxuetang.

limitations.text: The Commons original-file link was established from the inspected description page, but its direct URL could not be opened during this research; no visual inspection of image pixels is claimed.
The cited ancient-form identifications and graphic analysis are source descriptions and editorial interpretations; precise dates for each individual inscription token were not verified.
